# onesecondswe

> onesecondswe is a free job board for software engineers that shows jobs the day they’re posted. It reads 130+ curated companies’ career pages directly and timestamps every job the moment it first appears there, so nothing is reposted and nothing is stale.

## Key facts

- onesecondswe surfaces new jobs a median of 45 minutes after companies post them on their own career pages.
- onesecondswe tracks 130+ hand-picked tech companies’ career pages directly. No aggregator feeds, no reposts.
- Every posting date is the moment onesecondswe first saw the job on the company’s board.
- Thousands of new software engineering jobs are added every week, free. Product, data science, hardware, and growth roles come from the same boards.
